module_summary: Reservoir flow controller: a six-state Moore FSM tracks water level and rising/falling history from three sensors, decoding valve outputs from state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Encodes current water level plus whether the previous level was lower.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Three level sensors driving every FSM transition.

anchors.name: fr
anchors.why: State-decoded 4-bit valve vector split into fr2, fr1, fr0, dfr.

anchors.name: dfr
anchors.why: Supplemental valve open when level rose since last sensor change.

groups.name: level_fsm
groups.description: Level/trend state register and sensor-driven next-state logic.

groups.name: valve_decode
groups.description: Maps state to nominal and supplemental flow valve outputs.
